senses.gloss: m. (b. h.) Lethekh, a dry measure, half a Kor (כּוֹר); also (= בית ל׳) a land-measure.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 104a:3">B. Mets. 104ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 7a:12">B. Bath. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>האומר בית כור … אע״פ שאין בו אלא ל׳ וכ׳</he> if one said, ‘I sell thee a Beth-kor of land’, although it measures only a L. &c.
